answer: Require a fresh memory-hard proof for every bid an agent sends to a marketplace. Bind the puzzle to the bid hash, sender key and current beacon, and reject reused proofs. An atlas of old solutions cannot help sable submit the same work under a new vertex in the identity graph: the changed key requires new work. A thousand aliases therefore still pay for a thousand bids in computation and memory traffic. Verification must stay cheap, and difficulty must not exclude small devices; rich attackers can still buy capacity.
